body:
Finite complex-supplier circuit construction; no new κ. The selected PR799 X4 word’s zero-frame arbitrary-helper compensation shrinks from **6,320 to 3,276 additions**, including all target preparation and restoration. Both complete emitted programs save **33,800 real-component primitives** under the unchanged binary-Horner lowering.

| Full scalar program | Original | Candidate |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Forward real primitives | 193,162 | 159,362 |
| Inverse-transpose real primitives | 193,210 | 159,410 |
| Scalar macros, either orientation | 19,197 | 16,153 |

The 56-pair schedule implements `T⁻¹(Ty + TCh) = y + Ch` with arbitrary target/helper dirt. All source accesses, coefficient work, basis changes and clears are paid. No helper is written by the replacement. Every non-scalar event and paid child is unchanged. The reverse positive prefix rises slightly; budgets stay at **55/72 bits**.

Reproduce with Python 3.10+ and the standard library:
```sh
python3 -I -B research/complex-x4-compensation-pairs/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/complex-x4-compensation-pairs/test_package.py
```
Expected main marker: `PASS_X4_COMPENSATION_PAIRS pairs=56 compensation=6320->3276 saved_real=33800 columns=728+9 orientations=2 no_new_kappa`.

Verification covers every literal primitive on **728 logical plus nine arbitrary private input columns**, both orientations; an independently implemented sparse integer/dyadic engine checks the full baseline/candidate logical words and compensation boundary. Public dirty helpers restore; inherited private centres/coefficient work erase via charged CLEARs. Nine focused tests pass normally and under `-O`, including corruption controls, recompression and standalone relocation. A missing-preparation control passes helper-only checking but fails arbitrary-target checking. Selected-record integrity and its five existing tests pass.

The complete **24,864** ordered target-pair/sign census has **2,978** profitable scores; one seed-39 greedy disjoint pass selects 56 pairs. Recipe, census hash, complete prices, prefix bounds and program hashes are reproducible. No matching/circuit optimality claim.

Exact base: **f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631**. Inputs are unchanged accepted `integrated799-replay.tar.gz` members, matching PR799’s exact canonical/program pins. Only `research/complex-x4-compensation-pairs/` is added. Current main was refreshed unchanged; final PR inventory reaches #897. The API-published tree equals the tested local tree.

Credit **Sricharan Vagvala’s #749** for the rational restored target-pair mechanism on earlier JP8, following the #713/#716 binary work; its implementation is not imported. Credit **Jeremy Kothe #799**, **Chafik Boukhalfa #741**, **icekylinx’s gauge44**, and retained compiler/cold/owner contributors. Concurrent **Philipp (@mightyOil) #883** changes the preceding 168-macro precondition, which is byte-identical here; its code/saving is not consumed and no combined saving is claimed. #864 frame-only exclusion has different scope.

The accepted conditional κ remains **0.001661634653669567**. Production integration needs a typed alternative-compensation step and refreshed bindings, global hosting/invoice and assembly admission. No full supplier cold replay, repository-wide suite, hosted CI or Lean multiplication theorem is claimed. All-size/compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape, analytic transfer and bit H1–H5 remain inherited.

Prepared for **ToikY** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including a bounded delegated integer-checker implementation/review. Apache-2.0 and predecessor notices retained. No independent human review claimed.
title: Research construction: restored X4 target pairs save 33,800 primitives per orientation (no new kappa)
